extraction_notes: Identity verified: the supplied onsemi BC846ALT1G Series datasheet lists the exact ordering code BC847CLT1G in the ordering information on p. 12; the target is an NPN silicon transistor in the SOT-23 package.
The PDF is Rev. 17 dated January 2017 and has 13 pages; all pages were examined.

Real curve extraction was performed from the exact BC847C group typical-characteristics plots on p. 9 Figures 29 through 32 and p. 10 Figures 35 and 36. The emitted curves are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible TA = 25 degC traces at labeled grid positions; no points were interpolated or invented.

The hFE table gives a typical value of 270 for BC847C at IC = 10 mA and VCE = 5 V, and a guaranteed range of 420 minimum, 520 typical, and 800 maximum at IC = 2 mA and VCE = 5 V. These semantics are preserved as separate records.

VCE(sat) is published as a maximum of 0.25 V at IC = 10 mA, IB = 0.5 mA and a maximum of 0.6 V at IC = 100 mA, IB = 5.0 mA. VBE(sat) is published as typical 0.7 V and 0.9 V at those respective pairs. VBE(on) is also tabulated at IC = 2 mA and 10 mA but has no dedicated field in the strict schema; its 2 mA 580 mV minimum, 660 mV typical, 700 mV maximum row and 10 mA 770 mV maximum row are retained in the p. 9 curve and this note.

Cobo is represented by its published maximum of 4.5 pF at VCB = 10 V and f = 1 MHz, converted to F. The Cib trace is present in Fig. 35, but no Cibo table value or test bias is published, so specs.cibo is null.
V(BR)CEO is 45 V minimum at IC = 10 mA and TA = 25 degC. The separate maximum-rating VCEO for BC847 is also 45 V; breakdown and maximum-rating semantics are not conflated.
